structured.feedback: The response breaks the rule against repetitive language with the line "At 16 oz, this 16-ounce bottle". Its "Long-Lasting Value" section also overpromises: a reviewer said the bottle "goes pretty quick", and the product costs $59.99. It invents some details, such as "without stripping natural oils" and easier combing of dry hair, which neither the product details nor the reviews support.
